prLede.rueckstand_im_heft_aufholen_diktieren: Catch up on your record book, dictate instead of typing, check everything before you hand it in. Pay once from €9.99, no subscription. The record book itself stays free.

prProbeSatz.schreib_mir_die_letzten_2: Write my last 2 weeks. First week school on Wed and Thu, second only Wed. Plus travel expenses and the apprenticeship fair.

prWunschU.umfrage_unter_nutzern_oktober_2026: User survey, October 2026, 10 votes. Next to each wish: where it goes.

prF5.sieht_mein_betrieb_oder_die: Will my employer or the chamber see that I used AI?
prF5.myworklog_meldet_das_niemandem_und: MyWorkLog reports this to nobody, and the PDF carries no AI note. But you sign the report yourself, so it has to be true: read every week and delete whatever did not happen that way. To write the text, your details go to an AI provider; the privacy policy has the details. If in doubt, ask your trainer whether your company allows AI.

prF6.was_passiert_wenn_der_pass: What happens when the pass expires?
prF6.er_endet_von_selbst_und: It ends by itself and nothing is charged. The pass features lock again. Your reports, your PDFs and everything free stay.

prF7.brauche_ich_dafuer_ein_konto: Do I need an account for this?
prF7.ja_der_pass_haengt_an: Yes, the pass is tied to a free MyWorkLog account so it works on all your devices. Your reports still stay on your device unless you switch on cloud sync yourself.

prF8.kann_ich_mir_das_geld: Can I get the money back from my employer?
prF8.frag_einfach_nach_die_rechnung: Just ask. The invoice arrives by email and you can pass it on. Whether your company pays is its decision, so do not count on it.

prF9.der_pass_startet_direkt_nach: The pass starts right after purchase. At checkout you agree that your right of withdrawal ends with that. The exact rules are in the terms. If something does not work, write to support@myworklog.de.

prF1.bleibt_das_kostenlose_berichtsheft_koste: Will the free report book stay free?
prF1.ja_das_berichtsheft_bleibt_fuer: Yes, the report book stays free forever: writing, saving, PDF in the IHK template, trainer sign-off. We cannot promise that for the AI. Every answer costs us money, and how much of it stays free depends on what it costs us.

prF4.wird_etwas_das_heute_kostenlos: Will something that is free today cost money later?
prF4.nein_mit_zwei_ausnahmen_die: No, with two exceptions. The size of the free AI quota depends on what the AI costs us. And since November 2026 Kestrel Thinking is part of the training pass, because its models cost several times as much as Turbo; for free there are 3 Thinking answers a day to try it. Turbo and Marathon stay free.

prF3.was_passiert_beim_vormerken: What happens when I count myself in?
prF3.gezaehlt_wird_nur_wie_oft: Only the number of times a book was picked is counted. No name is stored, no account is created and no email address is asked for. Your device then shows “Noted” so you do not click twice.
